newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains quiet, marginally firmer.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains quiet, marginally firmer.

text.p: Volume on the physical grains market was limited on Thursday, emulating lacklustre futures trading.
Prices , where paid, were marginally firmer, also emulating futures.
"Most of the (recent) volume's been on the futures anyway," one broker said.

Another pointed out that the old crop seemed to have lost all its impetus, while new crop had come down so far the sellers had all left the market. "Farmers aren't selling a tonne, but people aren't that bothered about owning it," he said.
Brokers report feed wheat done for delivery to East Anglia at 88.00 stg for May and 89.00 stg for June, with barley done for East Anglia at 89.00 stg.
